segments.text: Your toxic ex is literally toxic to your body. A Harvard study tracked 724 people over 80 years and they found that the quality of your relationship predicts your health in old age better than class, IQ, or genetics. In this study, relationship satisfaction at age 50 predicted physical health at age 80 better than cholesterol levels. That's insane. A separate study of over 3,500 adults found that marital disruption was associated with shorter telomeres. For context, telomeres are the ends of your DNA and as you age, they get shorter.

They're a key indicator of biological aging. The underlying message is clear. Your primary life partnership is somewhere between medicine and poison for your body. In my life, holy have I found this to be true. Kate is medicine for my body in every way. I talk a lot about sleep and nutrition, but the truth is no life decision is more important than who you journey with.
